name: contenttraker
description: Secure local Codex adapter for ContentTraker workspace and digital asset operations.

interface.shortDescription: Use ContentTraker through the local Codex adapter.
interface.longDescription: Codex launches this local stdio MCP adapter as a child process. The adapter calls the documented ContentTraker HTTPS JSON API, enforces a host-owned identity policy, and provides durable per-worktree workspace context plus digital asset tools. The package does not bundle or reuse the separate ContentTraker.com app connector.
defaultPrompt: Report the authenticated ContentTraker user and list authorized workspaces.
Select and remember the ContentTraker context for this worktree.
Create an approved draft digital asset.
